verdicts.correction: Core claim holds. Re-checked on 2026-10-24 ~11:11Z: GET /v1/games/2753915549/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=10&excludeFullGames=true returned HTTP 200 with no cookie, item keys exactly [fps,id,maxPlayers,ping,playerTokens,players,playing], playerTokens [] and players []. The create-docs embedded spec contains operationId PublicServerBrowserService.GameInstances_GetServerList with security [{}, roblox-legacy-cookie], ServerType enum [0,1], SortOrder enum [1,2], and only 200/400/404 responses. /docs/cloud/legacy/games/v1 301-redirects to /docs/cloud/reference/domains/games, and games.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 returns 404. Two additions. (a) I found no 'last_updated 2026-10-23' marker in the page HTML, so that date is unverified. (b) The 400/404 bodies, which the spec leaves undescribed, are: 400 code 0 'Allowed values: 10, 25, 50, 100' (field limit); 400 code 7 'Guest users are not allowed.' for /servers/Friend and /servers/1 without a cookie; 404 code 1 'The place is invalid.' for placeId 1.

Reproduced. limit=20 returns 400 {code:0,message:'Allowed values: 10, 25, 50, 100',field:'limit'}. limit=100 on /v1/games/920587237/servers/0?sortOrder=1 returned 100 items plus a nextPageCursor. v2 with no limit returned 10 items. DevForum 3930693 confirmed: jpepsteve replied on 2025-09-12 that 'This was not an intended change' and promised advance notice of future changes. The same thread, post #2 by jerxl0l on 2025-09-12, also reported that nextPageCursor stopped after 90 servers at limit 10, 75 at 25 and 50 at 50 during that incident.

Reproduced exactly. 'x-ratelimit-limit: 3, 3;w=60'. The 400 for limit=20 consumed quota. The 4th call (place 920587237) and a 5th call to a DIFFERENT place (606849621) both got 429 with body {errors:[{code:0,message:''}]}, 'x-envoy-ratelimited: true', 'retry-after: 5' and 'x-retry-after-coverage: /v1/games/{placeId}/servers/{serverType}/', while x-ratelimit-reset was 53 then 52. So the bucket is per route template and per IP, and Retry-After understates the wait. Nuance the researcher missed: the window is aligned to the wall-clock minute, not a rolling 60 s from the first call. x-ratelimit-reset always counted down to hh:mm:59/00 (11:11:02→57, 11:11:34→26, 11:14:27→32, 11:15:01→58, 11:22:43→17). The same holds on apis.roblox.com universes (60/min).

Confirmed and slightly strengthened. Without a cookie, 'Guest users are not allowed.' (400 code 7) is returned by v2 /servers/Friend, by v1 /servers/Friend and /servers/1, and by v2 Public with orderBy=Recommended, orderBy=1 and orderBy=2. Recommended is now verified live, not only inferred from ServerList.js. Announcement 3966648 (jpepsteve, signed 'Roblox User Team', 2025-09-29) verified verbatim: it lists 'Limiting the number of servers a user can browse', 'Limiting the server list API to logged-in users only', and that 'Creators will not be restricted when loading more servers in experiences they have edit access to'. The topic auto-closed on 2026-04-24 with no staff follow-up in the thread. Guest v1 and v2 Public still return 200 as of 2026-10-24. The '5 tokens per server' 2024 report was not re-checked.

The main claim is right: the live game page still loads 4bb4b5e5…-ServerList.js, which calls `${gamesApi}/v2/games/${placeId}/servers/Public`. Friend lists use v1, or v2 when isFriendsServerListV2Enabled is on. Private servers use /v1/games/${placeId}/private-servers. v2 ignores sortOrder: sortOrder=Asc still returned 35/35 servers. The default-options part is WRONG. rX={sortOrder:'Desc',excludeFullGames:false} is only the base. For the PUBLIC list, the initial state is rX overridden with {orderBy: isAuthenticated ? 'Recommended' : 'OccupancyDesc', excludeFullGames: true}. So the website sends sortOrder=Desc&orderBy=Recommended|OccupancyDesc&excludeFullGames=true by default. Friend and private lists keep {sortOrder:'Desc', excludeFullGames:false}. Also, while more pages exist, the website trims the visible list to a multiple of 4 (r.length%4).

Confirmed: the route has its own 3/60 bucket (remaining=2 while v1 was exhausted). Addition: its cursor is byte-identical to v1's, including the same HMAC signature e5de8b3d… for place 2753915549 page 1. A cursor from one route is accepted by the other: a 10-page walk alternating v1 and the alias succeeded. There is still no servers endpoint on apis.roblox.com.

The researcher's own scan used excludeFullGames=false, which is not stated in the claim, while the DevForum report used excludeFullGames=true. I re-ran with excludeFullGames=true (sortOrder=Desc, limit=100, place 2753915549, no cookie, 2026-10-24): 10 pages, 1000 rows, 825 unique, 5 to 47 repeats per page, and nextPageCursor still non-null after page 10. So there is no cap for guests in either mode. Correction on the DevForum report (4294098): its 'Update 2' says the cursor also went null 7 pages deep at limit=50. That makes it a ~7-PAGE cap, not a 700-server cap. The report was made with .ROBLOSECURITY. Haydz6 (not staff) called it intentional.

Post 4537709 verified (Gryphscribe, 'Roblox Staff', 2026-03-25). It requires Read permission, and its FAQ says the browsing APIs 'have a low rate limit and are only intended to support administration'. Spec details the researcher left open, from create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/reference/features/observability: GET /server-management/v1/universes/{universeId}/places/{placeId}/versions/{versionNumber}/game-servers, operationId GameServers_ListGameServers, x-roblox-stability BETA. Security is roblox-legacy-cookie OR roblox-api-key OR roblox-oauth2 with scope 'universe:read'. Rate limit is 100/min per API-key owner and 100/min per OAuth2 authorization. Query params are MaxPageSize, PageToken, OrderBy and Filter (CEL on all fields, operators && < <= > >= == in). GameServer fields: placeId, placeVersion, jobId, engineVersion, createTime, uptime, memoryUsageBytes, frameRate, occupancy, maxOccupancy, type, full, shutDown, status, …. The researcher's snake_case filter list (place_id, job_id, player_id, …) was not found in the spec and is unverified. It needs a placeVersion in the path, and it only works for experiences the account can Read.

Reproduced: 2753915549 gives {universeId:994732206}, placeId 1 gives 200 {universeId:null}, and the header is 'x-ratelimit-limit: 60, 60;w=60'. MightyDantheman (not staff) also suggested this route in DevForum 3966648 #34.

Reproduced: 300/min, universeAvatarType returned as the string 'MorphToR15' while the spec says int enum [1,2,3], and isOfficiallyLicensed/isCommunityLicensed are present but not in the spec. The reverse also applies: spec fields creationSource, licenseDescription, localizedFiatPrice, refundLink and refundPolicy were absent from the guest response.

Spec and limits confirmed: both routes are STABLE, games/icons is 1200/min and places/gameicons 60/min, universeId 1 returns a GameIcon2 placeholder with state Completed, and 403 code 9 applies to the AutoGenerated policies. 'Results are not in input order' was NOT reproduced: both of my calls returned items in input order. Still match on targetId, since order is not documented.
Reproduced: 401 code 9002, 1000/min, spec security cookie-only and EXPERIMENTAL. RoSeal multigetPlacesByIds uses batchLimit 50 with repeated placeIds.

Reproduced the guest-visible parts: private-servers returns 401 9002 at 9/min. /v1/vip-servers/{id} returns 401. enabled-in-universe returns 200 {privateServersEnabled:false} for Blox Fruits, consistent with createVipServersAllowed:false from v1/games, at 200/min. The spec schemas (exclusiveStartKeyCursor, excludeFriendServers, gameJoinRestricted) match. The website calls the route with only {cursor} plus {sortOrder:'Desc', excludeFullGames:false}. Not verified: authenticated response contents and the 'accessCode only when joinable' behaviour, which is inferred from the website. The RoSeal privateServers.ts details were not re-checked.

Gating confirmed. A guest POST returns 200 with only the type and location fields filled; even offline users show lastLocation 'Website', and placeId/rootPlaceId/gameId/universeId are null. Rate is 60/min. Staff feriderk and Radicalius rolled back the 2025-04-25 leak. DevForum 3760427 (2025-06) independently found that full fields come back only when a Cookie header is sent. MultiAlt friends.md says 'sem cookie a Roblox omite o gameId' (without a cookie, Roblox omits the gameId) and gives placeId priority over rootPlaceId. Still unverified, as the researcher said: whether a self-query returns your own gameId, and what happens when your join privacy is 'No one'. Also: users in Team Create/Team Test show gameId null and universeId null with lastLocation 'Studio - …' (DevForum 3965606, 2025-09-28).

The cited reports are from mid-2025 and staff later said they were addressed. In DevForum 3678257, feriderk (Roblox Staff) wrote on 2025-11-12: 'we've shipped some fixes to the Presence system over the last few months that have significantly improved accuracy'. So 'slow and sometimes wrong' rests on pre-fix evidence. No 2026 source quantifies presence latency either way. The design conclusion (presence as a secondary check) is still reasonable, but the 'missing for minutes' evidence may be stale.

Bloxstrap ActivityWatcher.cs constants and regexes match verbatim, as do the 15 s CreationTime rule, FileShare.ReadWrite and the 'technically volatile' comment. MultiAlt roblox_log.rs header says formats were calibrated on client 0.743 logs on 15/10/2026, and uses GameJoinLoadTime 'userid:'/'placeid:', 'UDMUX Address = ' and 'Server Prefix: '. Corrections: (a) the current LIVE Windows client is already 0.744.0.7441080 (clientsettings.roblox.com, 2026-10-24), so 'current as of 0.743' is one release behind and unverified for 0.744. (b) roblox_log.rs does not itself match 'Replicator created' or 'leaveUGCGameInternal'; those come from Bloxstrap only. (c) The 8 s floor and 20 s cap come from MultiAlt multi-launch.md (cap = max(20 s, AccountJoinDelay)).

MultiAlt server-choice.md confirms one server per batch, excludeFullGames=true, playing + accounts <= maxPlayers, up to 6 Desc pages for best fit, a preferred spare seat, and dedupe by Job ID ('50 repetidos em 400 servidores', i.e. 50 repeated in 400 servers). Attribution fixes: server-choice.md does NOT mention RequestGameJob or the 8 s gap. The 8 s minimum ('delay = max(AccountJoinDelay, 8)', anti-captcha because of auth-ticket redemptions from the same IP) is in multi-launch.md. RequestGameJob/RequestFollowUser come from the website's GameLaunch.js (joinGameInstance → 'RequestGameJob', followPlayerIntoGame → 'RequestFollowUser'). GameLaunch.js contains no 'play-with-user'; that path comes from RoSeal/RoZod. friends.md says the follow mode is a UI toggle labelled 'helps avoid CAPTCHA', and the doc itself calls that an inference from a user report. RAM is archived with pushed_at 2024-10-01T21:05:34Z, confirmed.

Reproduced: /v1/join-game with no cookie returns 200 {status:12, message 'Unable to join Game 212' with a Roblox/ UA, joinTicket:null, queuePosition:0}. /v1/join-game-instance returns 401 9002. /v2/join-game-instance returns 404 {code:0,message:''}. 'x-ratelimit-limit: 5, 5;w=1'. create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/reference/domains/gamejoin, /docs/cloud/legacy/gamejoin/v1 and gamejoin.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 all return 404. RoValra history confirmed: dc95819 (2026-07-01) 'ported all gamejoin apis to gamejoin v2' and 82f631e (2026-09-20) 'removedf the gamejoin v2 check'. Nuance: RoValra serverApi.js STILL names /v2/join-game-instance and /v2/join-private-game, but api.js normalizeGameJoinEndpoint rewrites /v1/ and /v2/ to /v1/ and adds joinOrigin 'RoValraFetchInfo'. RoZod lists the same body fields and no top-level joinTicket, which confirms it is partly stale. RoSeal bodies also send overridePlatformType (default 'Desktop') and joinOrigin, which RoZod does not list.

RoSeal enum verified verbatim (7, 8 and 9 are commented as Unknown), and the 211..811 / 212..812 message mapping is verified. BTRoblox: 22 gives 'Server is full', 12 gives 'You do not have access to this place', and 2/6 are not handled. RoValra isServerActive accepts 2 or 22. Froststrap accepts only 2, but returns TRUE on HTTP 429 and false on 401/403. MultiAlt treats 12 as denied (error 524) and 6 as full, not a denial. Caveat the researcher missed: RoValra's api.js SYNTHESIZES {status:22, message:'Server full', rovalraTimedOut:true} when a gamejoin call exceeds GAMEJOIN_TIMEOUT_MS=2000. So RoValra's 'full' is partly its own timeout value, not Roblox's.

Reproduced: UA 'Roblox/WinInet' gives 'Unable to join Game 212', and the curl default UA gives 'Unable to join Game 211', both 200 with status 12. BTRoblox sends 'User-Agent: Roblox/WinInet' (Chrome via declarativeNetRequest rule 9010, removed after 5 s), sends no CSRF, and retries once after 1 s on 429. Froststrap sends UA 'Roblox/Froststrap' plus Cookie, Referer and Origin, with no CSRF. RoValra attaches X-CSRF-TOKEN to all mutating requests and retries on 403 with the x-csrf-token header. Whether an authenticated call needs CSRF is still untested. The 2024 DevForum UA script was not re-checked.

The community-tool parts check out. MultiAlt: ~0.9 s spacing, at most 40 per request, 'Resolver região em rajada toma 429 e marca a conta' (resolving regions in a burst gets a 429 and flags the account), and an access check once per account. RoValra: 100 ms minimum spacing, 2000 ms timeout and synthetic status 22, ServerClaimedTime for uptime, and UdmuxEndpoints[0].Address falling back to MachineAddress. BTRoblox uses the same address fallback. Froststrap: 3 attempts, 500 ms × attempt on 429/5xx, 250 ms × attempt on network errors, 1500 ms liveness timeout, and region from DataCenterId only. The core claims about authenticated behaviour (status 2 returns a full joinScript with ClientTicket/SessionId, no slot reservation) cannot be checked without a cookie. RoZod's schema shows ClientTicket inside joinScript, which supports but does not prove the claim.

missed.claim: The x-ratelimit window is a fixed window aligned to the wall-clock minute, not a rolling 60 s.
missed.detail: In every server-list and universes response, x-ratelimit-reset counted down to the next :00 second (11:11:02→57, 11:11:34→26, 11:14:27→32, 11:15:01→58, 11:22:43→17). A request made at hh:mm:50 gets only ~10 s of window. The token bucket should schedule against x-ratelimit-reset, never against 'retry-after: 5' and never against 'last request + 60 s'.

missed.claim: v1 and /v1/public-server-browser-service/ cursors can be used on either route, and each route has its own guest rate bucket.
missed.detail: Page-1 cursors from both routes decode to the same JSON plus the same HMAC (…"discriminator":"placeId:2753915549serverType:Public"…\ne5de8b3d…). A 10-page walk that alternated routes with the same cursor chain returned 200 on every page. Factual note only: this doubles the guest throughput to 6 per minute, but it relies on an undocumented alias that Roblox could close at any time. Do not build RoALT around it.

missed.claim: Probable mapping of ServerListSortOption values 0 to 4 for v2 orderBy (partly answers an open question; inferred, not confirmed).
missed.detail: Guest calls on place 920587237, limit=10: orderBy=0 and the default returned full servers (35/35), so 0 looks like Default/Unspecified with an occupancy-descending fallback. orderBy=1 and orderBy=2 returned 400 code 7 'Guest users are not allowed.', so they are Recommended and BestLatency in some order. orderBy=3 returned 35/35, likely OccupancyDesc. orderBy=4 returned playing=1, so OccupancyAsc. Prefer sending the string names, which are confirmed in ServerList.js.

missed.claim: Error body codes the server-list routes actually return, which the spec leaves undescribed.
missed.detail: 400 {code:0,message:'Allowed values: 10, 25, 50, 100',field:'limit'}. 400 {code:7,'Guest users are not allowed.'} for Friend or 1 without a cookie on v1 and v2, and for v2 orderBy Recommended, BestLatency, 1 or 2. 404 {code:1,'The place is invalid.'} for a nonexistent placeId (1). 429 {code:0,message:''}. Every one of these, 400s included, uses up quota.

missed.claim: The website's actual default query for the public list is sortOrder=Desc&excludeFullGames=true&orderBy=Recommended when logged in, or OccupancyDesc as a guest.
missed.detail: In ServerList.js (4bb4b5e5…, still served by www.roblox.com/games/920587237 on 2026-10-24), the public list starts from rX={sortOrder:'Desc',excludeFullGames:false} and overrides it with {orderBy: S ? r$.recommended : r$.occupancyDesc, excludeFullGames: true}. Friend and private lists keep rX. Mirroring this keeps RoALT's requests looking like the website's.

missed.claim: Roblox staff said in Nov 2025 that presence accuracy had been fixed. Most 'presence is wrong' evidence is from before that.
missed.detail: DevForum 3678257 #5, feriderk (Roblox Staff), 2025-11-12: fixes shipped 'over the last few months … significantly improved accuracy'. RoALT should still measure presence latency itself rather than assume minutes-long gaps.

missed.claim: Open Cloud server listing accepts the legacy cookie, the universe:read scope or an API key, at 100/min. RoALT could use it to show servers for the user's OWN experiences.
missed.detail: GET https://apis.roblox.com/server-management/v1/universes/{universeId}/places/{placeId}/versions/{versionNumber}/game-servers. security: roblox-legacy-cookie | roblox-api-key | roblox-oauth2['universe:read']. BETA. Rate 100/min per key owner or per OAuth authorization. Params MaxPageSize, PageToken, OrderBy, Filter (CEL). Items carry jobId, occupancy, maxOccupancy, frameRate, memoryUsageBytes, createTime, uptime, type, full and shutDown. Also listed: GameServers_GetFilterOptions and GameServers_ListGameServerLogs. Only for experiences with Read permission. The authenticated cookie path was not tested.

missed.claim: The current LIVE Windows client is 0.744.0.7441080, so log-format calibration needs a check each release.
missed.detail: GET https://clientsettings.roblox.com/v2/client-version/WindowsPlayer returns {version:'0.744.0.7441080', clientVersionUpload:'version-9ac8595712b447a7'}, and clientsettingscdn …/channel/LIVE returns the same. MultiAlt calibrated on 0.743. RoALT could record the client version next to each parsed log so that format drift can be detected.

missed.claim: RoSeal's gamejoin bodies include overridePlatformType and joinOrigin. Third-party tools disagree on how to treat a 429 from gamejoin.
missed.detail: RoSeal join.ts sends joinOrigin and overridePlatformType (default 'Desktop') on join-game-instance, join-private-game, join-reserved-game, play-with-user and join-game, with camelizeResponse. Froststrap's IsServerAliveAsync returns true on HTTP 429, while BTRoblox retries once after 1 s. RoALT should treat a 429 as 'unknown' and back off, never as 'joinable'.

missed.claim: The website also calls an apis gateway endpoint for private-server settings (unverified schema).
missed.detail: ServerList.js calls `${apiGatewayUrl}/private-servers-api/Universe-Private-Server-Settings` with GET {universeId} and withCredentials. It is a newer private-server settings source alongside /v1/private-servers/enabled-in-universe/{universeId}. Not curled, and the schema is unknown.
